a.lede: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago. They're now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.
a.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched

b.lede: OpenAI says researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol uncovered two critical PHP vulnerabilities with severity scores of 9.2 and demonstrated working exploits, after which the company coordinated fixes.
b.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT Sol helped uncover critical PHP flaws that could affect 70% of websites
